findings.title: MonoGame.Framework assembly reference (install folder or packages folder)

triggeredRules.title: MonoGame.Framework assembly reference (install folder or packages folder)
triggeredRules.explanation: The project references MonoGame.Framework as an assembly with a HintPath into the installer folder or into a packages folder next to the solution. Neither exists on a clean machine, and the version is fixed by the path.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator replaces the reference with a PackageReference to MonoGame.Framework.DesktopGL or MonoGame.Framework.WindowsDX at 3.8.6.1, chosen from the old platform.

triggeredRules.title: MonoGamePlatform build property
triggeredRules.explanation: The project sets MonoGamePlatform, which only the old MonoGame installer targets read. It also drives the OutputPath pattern bin\$(MonoGamePlatform)\... and the platform that Content.mgcb is built for.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator drops the property. The target platform comes from the package that the migrated project references, and Content.mgcb gets the matching /platform.

triggeredRules.title: Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Net usage
triggeredRules.explanation: The code uses the Microsoft.Xna.Framework.Net namespace (network sessions). It moved to MonoGame.Framework.Net in 3.3 and MonoGame 3.8 removed it.
triggeredRules.resolution: Replace the networking code with your own or a NuGet networking library. Stand-in types can be added with the compatibility shims (monogame-upgrade task 13.2).

triggeredRules.title: Microsoft.Xna.Framework.GamerServices usage
triggeredRules.explanation: The code uses the Microsoft.Xna.Framework.GamerServices namespace (Guide, SignedInGamer). It moved to MonoGame.Framework.Net in 3.3 and MonoGame 3.8 removed it.
triggeredRules.resolution: Remove the calls or use the compatibility shims (monogame-upgrade task 13.2).

triggeredRules.title: OpenTK API usage
triggeredRules.explanation: The code uses OpenTK types directly. The 3.8 DesktopGL package does not ship OpenTK, so these types no longer exist.
triggeredRules.resolution: Replace the OpenTK calls with MonoGame APIs or a NuGet OpenTK package of your choice. The migrator leaves a marker at each use (monogame-upgrade task 13.4).

triggeredRules.title: UWP API usage (Windows.UI.Xaml)
triggeredRules.explanation: The code uses UWP types from Windows.UI.Xaml. They exist only in a UWP project, and the migrated desktop project does not target UWP.
triggeredRules.resolution: Move this code into the platform project, which is copied unchanged, or replace it with a desktop equivalent. The migrator leaves a marker at each use (monogame-upgrade task 13.4).

triggeredRules.title: Color.TransparentBlack (removed in 3.8.1)
triggeredRules.explanation: Color.TransparentBlack was marked obsolete in MonoGame 3.8 and removed in 3.8.1. It and Color.Transparent are both (0, 0, 0, 0), so the replacement does not change behavior.
triggeredRules.resolution: The migrator replaces Color.TransparentBlack with Color.Transparent in files that import Microsoft.Xna.Framework.
